meta.title: Neurorehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Restoring movement, independence and quality of life after neurological injury.

overview: At Cambridge Hospital, our neurology and neurorehabilitation service supports adults and children living with conditions affecting the brain, spinal cord and nervous system.

A consultant-led interdisciplinary team - including neurologists, rehabilitation physicians, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, speech and language therapists and clinical psychologists - builds individualised programmes focused on restoring function, protecting independence and improving quality of life across inpatient, outpatient and home care settings.
